mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5pp but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand weakness that compresses corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock characterized by industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) during elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) compresses profit margins and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction above 1000 thousand units signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases above 1000 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in consumer price index above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increases above 3.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines below 5.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in consumer spending above 450,000 million dollars signals robust household consumption that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds 450000 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.
